definitions.explanation: The act of waking from sleep or a state of unconsciousness. Used in both literal and figurative senses.

definitions.gloss: arousal; activation of a latent ability or awareness
definitions.explanation: Becoming aware of something previously unrecognized, or the activation of a dormant power or talent. Frequently used in fiction and media to describe a character unlocking hidden abilities.

notes: Composed of {覚|かく} (perceive, awake) + {醒|せい} (sober, awake). Common collocations: {覚醒|かくせい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to awaken), {覚醒|かくせい}⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧ (waking state), {覚醒|かくせい}⟦{作用|さよう}→作用：05761_sayou⟧ (stimulant effect). The compound {覚醒剤|かくせいざい} refers to stimulant drugs (methamphetamine), which is a controlled substance in Japan — this is a formal/legal term frequently seen in news reports. In medical contexts, {覚醒|かくせい} specifically means regaining consciousness after anesthesia or coma. In gaming and anime, {覚醒|かくせい} is extremely common to describe characters unlocking new powers or transformations.
